mapper.insert: INSERT INTO facts (id, kb_id, subject_id, predicate_id, object_id, valid_from, valid_from_precision, valid_to, valid_to_precision, confidence, attested_from, attested_to, valid_from_grade) VALUES (#{id}, #{kbId}, #{subjectId}, #{predicateId}, #{objectId}, #{from}, #{fromPrecision}, #{to}, #{toPrecision}, #{confidence}, COALESCE(#{attestedAt}, now()), CASE WHEN #{toPrecision}::text = 'unknown' THEN COALESCE(#{attestedAt}, now()) END, #{fromGrade})

INSERT INTO facts (id, kb_id, subject_id, predicate_id, object_value, valid_from, valid_from_precision, valid_to, valid_to_precision, confidence, attested_from, attested_to, valid_from_grade) VALUES (#{id}, #{kbId}, #{subjectId}, #{predicateId}, #{objectValue,typeHandler=tech.seexun.jknow.store.typehandler.JsonNodeTypeHandler}, #{from}, #{fromPrecision}, #{to}, #{toPrecision}, #{confidence}, COALESCE(#{attestedAt}, now()), CASE WHEN #{toPrecision}::text = 'unknown' THEN COALESCE(#{attestedAt}, now()) END, #{fromGrade})
mapper.update: UPDATE facts SET invalidated_at = now() WHERE id = #{factId}
UPDATE facts SET supersedes = #{oldId} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO fact_evidence (fact_id, chunk_id, quote, proposed_predicate, document_id, doc_version, quote_start, quote_end) SELECT #{to}, chunk_id, quote, proposed_predicate, document_id, doc_version, quote_start, quote_end FROM fact_evidence WHERE fact_id = #{from} ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
INSERT INTO fact_qualifiers (fact_id, qualifier_type_id, value, entity_id) SELECT #{to}, qualifier_type_id, value, entity_id FROM fact_qualifiers WHERE fact_id = #{from} ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE facts SET attested_from = least(attested_from, #{at}), attested_to = CASE WHEN attested_to IS NULL OR NOT #{ended} THEN attested_to ELSE least(attested_to, #{at}) END WHERE id = #{factId}
mapper.select: SELECT invalidated_at IS NULL FROM facts WHERE id = #{factId} FOR SHARE
SELECT id FROM facts WHERE supersedes = #{factId} ORDER BY invalidated_at IS NULL DESC, recorded_at DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO fact_evidence (fact_id, chunk_id, quote, proposed_predicate, document_id, doc_version, quote_start, quote_end) SELECT #{factId}, #{chunkId}, #{quote}, left(#{proposed}, 120), c.document_id, c.doc_version, #{quoteStart}, #{quoteEnd} FROM chunks c WHERE c.id = #{chunkId} ON CONFLICT (fact_id, chunk_id) DO UPDATE SET proposed_predicate = COALESCE(fact_evidence.proposed_predicate, EXCLUDED.proposed_predicate), quote_start = COALESCE(fact_evidence.quote_start, EXCLUDED.quote_start), quote_end = COALESCE(fact_evidence.quote_end, EXCLUDED.quote_end)
mapper.select: SELECT value FROM fact_qualifiers WHERE fact_id = #{factId} AND qualifier_type_id = #{qualifierTypeId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO fact_qualifiers (fact_id, qualifier_type_id, value) VALUES (#{factId}, #{qualifierTypeId}, #{value,typeHandler=tech.seexun.jknow.store.typehandler.JsonNodeTypeHandler}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT q.fact_id, q.qualifier_type_id, r.key, r.label, q.value, q.entity_id, e.canonical_name AS entity_name FROM fact_qualifiers q JOIN relation_types r ON r.id = q.qualifier_type_id LEFT JOIN entities e ON e.id = q.entity_id WHERE q.fact_id = ANY(#{factIds,typeHandler=tech.seexun.jknow.store.typehandler.UuidArrayTypeHandler}::uuid[]) ORDER BY q.fact_id, r.key
SELECT id FROM facts WHERE layer = 'open' AND kb_id = #{kbId} AND subject_id = #{subjectId} AND phrase = #{phrase} AND object_id = #{objectId} AND invalidated_at IS NULL ORDER BY recorded_at LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO facts (id, kb_id, subject_id, layer, phrase, object_id, confidence, attested_from) VALUES (#{id}, #{kbId}, #{subjectId}, 'open', #{phrase}, #{objectId}, #{confidence}, #{attestedAt})

INSERT INTO facts (id, kb_id, subject_id, layer, phrase, object_value, confidence, attested_from) VALUES (#{id}, #{kbId}, #{subjectId}, 'open', #{phrase}, #{objectValue,typeHandler=tech.seexun.jknow.store.typehandler.JsonNodeTypeHandler}, #{confidence}, #{attestedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE facts SET valid_from = #{from}, valid_from_precision = #{fromPrecision}, valid_to = #{to}, valid_to_precision = #{toPrecision}, valid_from_grade = #{grade}, attested_to = CASE WHEN #{to}::timestamptz IS NULL AND #{toPrecision} = 'unknown' THEN COALESCE(attested_to, attested_from, recorded_at) END WHERE id = #{factId} AND layer = 'open' AND invalidated_at IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO statement_qualifiers (fact_id, role, value, entity_id) VALUES (#{factId}, #{role}, #{value,typeHandler=tech.seexun.jknow.store.typehandler.JsonNodeTypeHandler}, #{entityId}) ON CONFLICT (fact_id, role) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT q.fact_id, q.role, q.value, q.entity_id, e.canonical_name AS entity_name FROM statement_qualifiers q LEFT JOIN entities e ON e.id = q.entity_id WHERE q.fact_id = ANY(#{factIds,typeHandler=tech.seexun.jknow.store.typehandler.UuidArrayTypeHandler}) ORDER BY q.fact_id, q.role
mapper.update: UPDATE facts SET confidence = 1.0 WHERE id = #{factId} AND kb_id = #{kbId} AND invalidated_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT count(*) FROM entities WHERE kb_id = #{kbId}
SELECT count(*) FROM facts WHERE kb_id = #{kbId}
mapper.update: UPDATE facts SET supersedes = NULL WHERE kb_id = #{kbId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM fact_evidence WHERE fact_id IN (SELECT id FROM facts WHERE kb_id = #{kbId})
mapper.update: UPDATE entities SET merged_into = NULL WHERE kb_id = #{kbId}
